limitations: Weights are analyst choices, not calibrated effect sizes or likelihood ratios.
PR05 is a discretionary assumption scenario; the underlying acoustic audit remains causally underdetermined.
Source families and correlated motion/model findings are not independent votes.
Zero missing-chain penalty is not validation, and actual historical chains remain unresolved.
The score of a broad family versus a specified sequence has a specificity disadvantage.
No simulation, media analysis, source authentication or scientific reproduction is performed by this tally.
